featured_reviews.name: sachin kamat
featured_reviews.review_text:
Form is awesome, content needs to match up to it & this team can do it!

Here are the things we loved :
- imaginative menu
- lovely ambiance
- friendly staff
- comes with an awesome reputation
- the Mahabaleshwar patties was super

Here are things that can be better:
- thanks to the reputation & first hand experience of Soam the expectation is very high and any lapse can make a big difference
- the food needs to match - the menu which is very thoughtful : few examples (1) Bharli Vangi served needed to be authentic, for the promise, expectation and price - what was served was deep fried brinjals mixed with green masala, which had lots of oil floating on it : Expectation was authentic stuffed / bharli brinjal (2) The Grandma’s fresh green chana - when we checked was dried green chana soaked overnight! The promise and the delivery needs to match (3) the Maharashtrian platter was super greasy and soaked in oil (4) The portions are abysmal- the Potli Biriyani was minuscule & the Jowar Roti accompanying the Bharli Brinjal were a tad bigger than poories!

All in all - you have built a great reputation, you have an awesome venue, we know you have the capability - please please please deliver on the quality, authenticity and portions of the food - that’s what we come there for in the first place

Please see this as a fans review - I want to come there often and enjoy the menu you have promised!

featured_reviews.name: Bomi Manekshaw
featured_reviews.review_text:
The concept of a high tea unlimited buffet would seem attractive to the Indian pallet. Most food items like the two bite burger or the singal piece sev puri are certainly not items to be eaten cold and stale in a buffet.
The service was pleasent but excruciatingly slow for the 90 plus year old ladies who visited more for the experience than to demonstrate their poor appetite. The only item that they thought would be worth having with a hot coffee or tea were the bhajiyas.

And, the staff tested the ladies patience of taking almost 30 minutes plus to heat and serve them. Thank God the flavour of the mango mousse in the tiny cutting chai glass was the saving grace for these oldies. But, at ₹725/- (including taxes) per person this was certainly more premium a price for being next to the Bhavan's and Wilson College clientele than the food, service or lounging.

While the decore has some antique stuff like the ancient telephone ... overall they have the opportunity to work a lot on the atmosphere too.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback about your experience at Aamchee.
We truly appreciate your honest observations. Our intention with the Aamchee High Tea experience is to create a nostalgic and relaxed Mumbai-style gathering, and we’re sorry to hear that certain aspects — especially the service timing and freshness of some items — did not meet expectations for your group.
We especially regret the long wait for the bhajiyas, particularly for your elderly guests. That is certainly not the experience we aim to deliver at Aamchee, and your feedback has been shared with our team for immediate review and improvement.
We’re glad the mango mousse could provide a small redeeming moment, and we appreciate your comments on the ambience and overall offering as well. Constructive feedback like yours helps Aamchee improve both the experience and hospitality we strive to offer every guest.
We hope to have the opportunity to serve you again with a much warmer and smoother experience in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Crystal Restaurant at Chowpatty is one of those classic places in Mumbai that has built its reputation over many years by serving consistently good food. Located close to the famous Girgaon Chowpatty, it’s a convenient spot to visit after enjoying the sea breeze or an evening walk on the beach.

The restaurant is known mainly for its simple yet delicious North Indian and vegetarian dishes. Their Punjabi thali, dal makhani, paneer preparations, and butter rotis are especially popular among regular customers. The food is rich in flavor, well-cooked, and feels like traditional home-style North Indian cuisine. Portion sizes are also quite generous, making it a good value-for-money place, especially if you’re dining with family.

One thing that stands out about Crystal is its old-school charm. The interiors are simple and not overly fancy, but the place has a warm and nostalgic feel that many longtime visitors appreciate. The staff is generally polite and efficient, and even during busy hours they try their best to serve quickly.

Another positive point is the location. Being so close to Chowpatty makes it a great stop for a proper meal after having street food or spending time by the beach. Many locals and tourists visit this restaurant when they want something more filling than snacks.

However, during peak hours the place can get quite crowded, and you might have to wait for a table. The ambiance is also more traditional than modern, so those expecting a luxury dining experience might find it a bit basic.

featured_reviews.name: Swad Stories
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited Govinda's Restaurant near Chowpatty, Girgaon, and had a wonderful dining experience. What makes this place truly unique is that, being associated with the ISKCON Temple Trust, they do not use garlic or onions in any of their preparations. Despite this, the food is incredibly flavorful and satisfying, proving that great taste doesn't always need conventional ingredients.

The menu offers a wide variety of options across different cuisines. We started our meal with a selection of soups including Artichoke Bisque, Minestrone, Manchow, Tomato Lemongrass, and Laksa Soup. Each soup had a distinct flavor profile and was perfectly balanced. My personal favorite was the Artichoke Bisque Soup, as it was my first time trying it and I absolutely loved its rich, creamy texture and unique taste.

For starters, we ordered the Kung Pao Paneer and Masala Papad. The paneer was well-cooked with just the right amount of spice, while the masala papad made for a light and crunchy accompaniment.

In the main course, we enjoyed Paneer Lababdar and Dal Tadka paired with Jeera Rice. The gravies were comforting, flavorful, and complemented the rice beautifully.

The highlight of the meal was undoubtedly the Sizzling Brownie. Served hot and indulgent, it was the perfect way to end the dining experience.

Overall, Govinda's is a small yet charming restaurant with a constant flow of patrons, which speaks volumes about its popularity. If you're looking for delicious vegetarian food with a unique sattvic approach, this place is definitely worth a visit.

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
5 Stars for the Food
1 Star for the Pricing

I generally try not to give low ratings to businesses and prefer to give them the benefit of the doubt whenever possible.

However, fairness in reviewing also means pointing out issues when they arise.

Amar Juice Centre has long been a popular spot opposite Girgaon Chowpatty for quick snacks and street-style dishes. I’ve visited here multiple times over the years and have generally enjoyed the food.

On this visit, I ordered the Dahi Puri, which as always was excellent. The flavours were well balanced, the puris were crisp, and the overall taste was exactly what one expects from a good Mumbai chaat spot. In terms of quality, taste, and preparation, the food easily deserves five stars.

However, the pricing is where the experience becomes difficult to justify. The last time I visited, around 2024, the Dahi Puri was roughly ₹90. On this visit it was priced around ₹180 before taxes. That represents nearly a 100% increase in a relatively short period of time.

While some increase due to inflation is understandable, such a steep jump in pricing over roughly a year or two feels excessive from the perspective of a regular customer. Inflation sits generally at 5% a year not 50% a year!!

So while the food and service remain very good, and pretty much exactly as it was 2 years ago, the pricing makes the overall value difficult to justify.
